answer: Trust propagation limits sybils: each epoch, SybilRank-style random walks of 6 steps start from 50 seeded agents, and an account's score is the walk mass it receives divided by its degree. A raven farm can mint unlimited opal-bright fake nodes, but they connect to the honest vine through only a few attack edges, each costing 5 POA of stake, so every extra identity dilutes the farm's mass and cannot pass the 0.8 percentile cutoff. Validators recompute the walks from the public edge list.
